register.labelZh: DOUBLE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: double as 和 double up as 能幫助你說明房間、物件或建築物除了原來的用途外,還有另一種用途。；當路線錯誤、封閉或不安全,需要掉頭返回時,可以使用 double back。；double over 和 double up 可以描述某人因劇痛或大笑而突然彎下身。；double something over 可以表示把物件對摺;double up 則可以表示多人需要共用房間或床。
register.summaryEn: Double as and double up as help you explain that a room, object or building has a second purpose. Double back is useful when someone turns around and returns because the original route is wrong, closed or unsafe. Double over and double up can describe how someone bends sharply because of strong pain or laughter. Double something over describes folding, while double up helps you explain that people need to share a room or bed.
